narratives.Description: Acceptance-evidence refusal names items[N] and ignores acceptance.clauses
narratives.Overview:
- Change walkItems path prefix in evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate from "items" to "plan.items" so refusals, pass listings, and formatAcceptanceCompletionListing print plan.items[N] and nested plan.items[N].subItems[M] / plan.items[N].items[M].
- In the same refusal / remediation trailer, add an explicit sentence: write evidence/disposition on the plan item at the reported path; this gate does not read evidence/disposition from plan.acceptance.clauses[]. Prefer unconditional wording (not only when both arrays exist).
- Update acceptance-evidence unit expectations that hard-code path: "items[…]" (including substring/nested forms) to plan.items[…]; add focused regression: with both arrays present, clause-only evidence still refuses and names the exact plan.items[N] target plus the non-stamp sentence; valid evidence on the corresponding item passes.
- Do not dual-read or dual-write evidence onto plan.acceptance.clauses[]; keep Prefer-A reject C.
- Keep #4877 (provenance mint copy), #4879 (already-terminal landing), and #4881 (already-completed File not found) out of this remainder.
- Name the printed path as a qualified object path (plan.items[N]), not an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer; drop JSON-pointer-shaped wording from CHANGELOG/docs.
- file_scope: packages/core/src/scope/acceptance-evidence.ts (+tests) + CHANGELOG.md. Thin commands.md cite only if the same-ship refusal string is quoted there.
